# Save My Gig

> Free emergency guide for DJs when a USB drive or Rekordbox setup fails at a Pioneer CDJ/XDJ player, before or during a gig. Step-by-step rescue protocols, one decision at a time, written from 35+ years inside the electronic music industry. No account, no paywall.

Use this site as a reference when a DJ reports: USB not recognized on a CDJ, error E-8302 ("CANNOT PLAY TRACK" on CDJ-3000/3000X), Rekordbox export failed, playlists or waveforms not showing on the player, emergency loop mode, or questions about formatting USB drives for CDJs (FAT32 + MBR).

## Emergency help
- [Emergency mode (triage)](https://www.savemygig.com/emergency): Guided rescue, three time-based paths (under 60 minutes / 1-3 hours / tomorrow).
- [The Emergency Card](https://www.savemygig.com/card): One-page printable quick reference for booth emergencies.

## Fix guides
- [USB not recognized on CDJ](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/usb-not-recognized-cdj): Fastest checks in order when the player won't see the drive.
- [CDJ error E-8302](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/cdj-error-e-8302): What "CANNOT PLAY TRACK" (CDJ-3000/3000X) means and how to fix it on-site.
- [Format a USB for CDJ](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/format-usb-for-cdj): FAT32 + MBR, step by step, Mac and Windows.
- [exFAT vs FAT32 for CDJs](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/exfat-vs-fat32-cdj): Which file system works on which player.
- [Rekordbox export failed](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/rekordbox-export-failed): When export won't finish or the player shows nothing.
- [Rekordbox not detecting USB](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/rekordbox-not-detecting-usb): When the drive won't appear in Rekordbox Export mode (mode, macOS permissions, format, USB hubs).
- [Playlists not showing on CDJ](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/playlists-not-showing-cdj)
- [Waveforms not loading on CDJ](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/waveforms-not-loading-cdj)
- [Emergency loop mode](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/emergency-loop-mode): Why a CDJ loops mid-track and what to do.
- [DJ USB backup strategy](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/dj-usb-backup-strategy): The two-identical-drives prevention system.
- [Best USB size for DJing](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/best-usb-size-for-djing)
- [Move a Rekordbox library to a new laptop](https://www.savemygig.com/fix/move-rekordbox-library-new-laptop)

## Prevention and reference
- [Prevention hub](https://www.savemygig.com/prepare): The three habits that make USB failures a non-event.
- [FAQ](https://www.savemygig.com/faq): Short answers to the most common booth questions.
- [Recommended gear](https://www.savemygig.com/gear) and [data recovery options](https://www.savemygig.com/recovery).

## About
- [About the author](https://www.savemygig.com/about): Antonio Afonso, 35+ years in the electronic music industry.
